services.desc: Our Leave No Trace clinic teaches Gilpin County youth how to enjoy the outdoors responsibly by minimizing their impact on the environment. Through hands-on activities, they learn the seven core principles, including proper waste disposal, respecting wildlife, and protecting natural spaces. The clinic empowers young adventurers to become mindful stewards of the land. Exploring the great outdoors offers endless opportunities for adventure and rejuvenation, but it’s crucial to minimize our impact on the environment.
